_comment: Fixture corpus for the tool-attribution gate. One file, used four ways, so
the client-side hook and the CI gate are held to the same definition:
1. scripts/check_attribution.py must FLAG every sample in `bad`.
2. scripts/check_attribution.py must NOT flag any sample in `good`.
3. .githooks/commit-msg must REMOVE every `bad` line it is handed.
4. .githooks/commit-msg must PRESERVE every `good` line it is handed.
A gate that only ever runs against clean input cannot tell you it still
works. 1 and 3 prove it is not vacuous; 2 and 4 prove it has not grown so
broad that it would strip a real contributor's trailer or flag neutral
prose. Checking only one direction is how a gate passes while drift
accumulates in the direction things actually change.
